description: Repository: Jidoka. Keep stable completed conversation separate from an active snapshot and promote resumed work only after success. Acceptance: resume and recovery continue the correct turn; cancelled work does not leak; source and fork conversations remain isolated.

comments.text: Implemented in Jidoka commit 6a0337d6. Snapshots now record their completed-conversation revision. Resume, recovery, checkpoint, and fork reject stale active work. Caller-owned and stored resume use the same validation. Tests cover successful promotion, cancelled isolation, expired-lease recovery, independent source/fork promotion, and stale rejection. Validation: 654 passed, 38 excluded; focused parity 5 passed; mix quality passed.

title: Reconcile hibernate, resume, recovery, and fork continuation
